title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
1:1 details
Date: 2026-02-28
Time: 30m
Attendees: Taylor Nguyen (PM), Jordan Khan (Eng Lead)
Goal: quick sync on outstanding items across Hosted API, Console rollout, Dedicated capacity planning, and Private deployment readiness. Surface blockers and align on priorities for the next 2 sprints.

Quick status bullets (what I want Jordan to confirm / validate):
- Hosted API: p95 token latency improved after kernel selection change - internal metric: p95 for 2k context down from 320ms -> 270ms (still seeing variance under burst). Need confirmation on whether autotuner patch will go the week of 3/8. (Linked: JIRA-4892)
- Console: rollout plan for per-route dashboards - UX complete, backend PR in review (GH PR #789). Need timing for canary (10% traffic) and rollback criteria. Is ops runbook ready?
- Dedicated: capacity forecasting for Q2 commits - current pool utilization 78% across east/west. Ask about headroom assumptions and expected autoscale behavior for scheduled jobs. (JIRA-5010)
- Private: first on-prem customer install next month - checklist shows KMS integration incomplete and audit logging gaps. Need ETA on KMS work or a mitigation plan (temporary HSM proxy?).

Known blockers / risks to raise:
- Autoscaler occasionally overshoots during sudden bursts causing 60s provisioning latency spikes; impacts Dedicated SLA demos. Suspect warm-pool sizing and cooldown tuning.
- KMS integration for Private: security sign-off pending until KMS e2e tested. If delayed, customer install may shift by ~2 weeks.
- Console canary metrics: we need a clear set of SLOs to evaluate (latency, error rate, CPU spike). Ops runbook currently missing the exact thresholds.

Decisions I want to make in this 1:1:
1) Approve the autotuner patch canary for hosted API (if Jordan is confident error/latency risk is low).
2) Agree on Dedicated capacity buffer to commit for Q2 (options: 15% buffer vs 25% buffer).
3) Accept mitigation plan for Private KMS if full integration slips (temporary HSM proxy + documented risk).

Agenda / timebox:
- 5m: quick sync + wins (kernel perf improvements)
- 10m: Dedicated capacity / Q2 commit discussion
- 8m: Console canary & runbook readiness
- 5m: Private/KMS follow-up + action items

Action items (capture in doc and follow up in Slack):
- Jordan - confirm autotuner canary date and rollback conditions; push patch to staging by 2026-03-03. (Owner: Jordan Khan; due: 2026-03-03)
- Taylor - draft Dedicated commit proposal (15% and 25% scenarios) and send to finance for preliminary pricing impact. (Owner: Taylor Nguyen; due: 2026-03-04)
- Jordan + Ops - produce runbook with explicit SLO thresholds for Console canary and circulate to product + SRE. (Owners: Jordan Khan, Ops team; due: 2026-03-05)
- Alicia - run KMS integration smoke tests and report failures; if >1 blocker, propose HSM proxy fallback. (Owner: Alicia Chen; due: 2026-03-02)

Notes to self / prompts for Jordan:
- Ask how much buffer we realistically need for Dedicated to keep 99.9% throughput under predictable bursts. Prefer Jordan's rule-of-thumb (historical spikes + 20%?)
- Get clarity on who will own post-canary monitoring alerts for Console (ops vs eng oncall).
- Confirm whether Private pre-install checklist can be signed off by security on current timelines.

Open questions / follow-ups for next 1:1:
- If autotuner introduces regression on a small subset of models, what is our rollback cadence? (fast rollback + revert vs patch forward)
- Metrics: agree to export per-route cost breakdown for Dedicated customers by 2026-03-12 (Taylor to add request to analytics backlog).

References / links I want handy in the meeting:
- JIRA-4892 (autotuner perf experiment)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/789
- JIRA-5010 (Dedicated capacity forecasting spreadsheet link in Confluence)
- Console rollout confluence page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PROD/pages/Console+Rollouts

Tone: keep it high level, unblockers only - leave detailed tech deep dives for post-1:1 follow-up sessions.

Quick draft notes to paste into Slack after meeting:
- "Thanks Jordan - agreed to canary autotuner (staging by 3/3), Dedicated commit options reviewed (Taylor to send finance scenarios), Console canary runbook requested (ops+eng to deliver by 3/5), Alicia to complete KMS smoke tests by 3/2. Will follow up with a short doc + owners."

Misc scratch:
- Might be worth proposing a short cross-functional weekly triage call for Console canaries while we run the 10% traffic test (15min standup Mon/Wed).
- Keep an eye on token-cost changes if autotuner increases kernel memory pressure (could increase per-token cost).

End of prep notes.
